correction.what: The issuer pinned by install run 39369082339 and set in CORRIDRA_CUSTOMER_ISSUER was wrong. It named the Neon Auth service of Neon project neon-corridra (ep-shiny-glade, c-6, /neondb/auth), which has never held a user. The production app signs users in through the Neon Auth service of the app database branch: https://ep-tiny-forest-b199wxno.neonauth.c-5.eu-central-1.aws.neon.tech/corridra/auth (Neon project corridra-nonprod, branch corridra-live-synthetic, database corridra, email through Resend).
correction.cause: the issuer was taken from an assumption instead of the Neon Auth configuration of the branch the app database runs on, and no signed-in flow was exercised before the release was called done
correction.found: the owner's sign-up for an address that already had a verified account produced no code; diagnosing it located the real auth database
correction.impact: fail closed: customer sessions could not match the pin, so no customer principal, workspace or session proof was ever created (all counts 0 before the correction)
correction.fix: owner-approved one-time transaction on the production app database: guarded to run only with the customer tables empty, the single wrong row and an active service executor; disabled configuration_immutable, deleted the wrong row, inserted the c-5 issuer with the same executor 3f0f6baa-b7d8-48c1-9d12-b4070380f5ac, re-enabled the trigger. Independent SQL afterwards: one configuration row with the c-5 issuer, trigger enabled, 0 customer principals. CORRIDRA_CUSTOMER_ISSUER updated to the same value.
